entries.text:
SEC. 2862. PRINCIPAL OFFICE OF AVIATION HALL OF FAME.

    Section 23107 of title 36, United States Code, is amended by 
striking ``Dayton,'' and all that follows through ``trustees'' and 
inserting ``Ohio''.
